LLMs are probabilistic by nature. Auditing them with another probabilistic tool doesn't solve the problem — it compounds it. A system that is itself uncertain cannot render certain judgments about other systems. No LLM-based audit tool can

K9 Audit is causal AI applied to the audit problem. It does not generate or guess — it verifies. Every agent action is recorded into a **CIEU Ledger** — a five-tuple causal evidence unit that captures precisely: who acted, what they did, wh

The CIEU Ledger is not a log. It is a causal evidence ledger. Records are SHA256 hash-chained. Nothing can be silently modified or retroactively falsified. Forensic-grade auditing demands visibility, transparency, tamper-proofness, and repr
> K9 Audit is not about solving our puzzle. It is about finally solving yours.
